answer_1.quote: our work presents the first systematic investigation of how pruning affects fairness in LLM-generated summaries.

answer_2.quote: Performance: the quality of the generated summaries is evaluated through comparison with the corresponding reference summaries using two automatic evaluation metrics, ROUGE, an n-gram overlapping metric, and, BERTScore, an embedding-based evaluation metric. We evaluate model fairness using multiple metrics: Second-Order SPD (SPD), Binary Unfair Rate (BUR), Unfair Error Rate (UER), and Second-Order Fairness (SOF).

answer_4.quote: We conduct a systematic comparison of output fairness across five pruning methods using human evaluation. ... annotators identified distinct positive and negative opinions in each input, then assess which summary better preserves the original opinion distribution
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two AI-generated summaries and determine which one maintains better proportional fairness by matching the original reviews' opinion distribution ratio.
